Image 2 (bamboo archer SW/06) is ONLY a lower-body southwest camera/projection reference for coordinated hips/knees/ankles and heel-to-toe axes; do not copy her identity, clothes, weapons, proportions or replace image 1's gait phase. Image 3 is the correctly directed adjacent Moon Shadow frame, identity and continuity reference only. Image 4 is the major approved painted style/material reference only; no UI.
The large front leg and front boot on screen-right already have the correct southwest projection: DO NOT change that front leg or boot. Correct ONLY the small bent rear leg and boot under the screen-left side of the body: the boot is too frontal/inward. Turn the rear knee, ankle and boot together so its heel-to-toe axis points southwest/lower-left parallel to the front boot, with natural foreshortening. Retain the same tucked rear-leg bend, height and approximate location. Do not open the stance.
Strict invariants: preserve ALL image 1 above the hip—silver bob, purple eyes, face, hair ornament, navy scarf, torso/waist decorations, arms, hands, both crescent daggers in original hands and original positions. Preserve navy trousers and gold-trim crescent boots with ornaments, chibi proportions, subject size, exact whole-canvas framing, original gait timing 75 ms of a 16-frame 1200 ms sequence. No cropping, zooming, recentering, mirroring, new shadows, text, green clothing or bow. Only paint the anatomically corrected lower limbs; no mechanical warping. Bright clean rounded Daoist chibi polished painted finish.
CRITICAL corrective emphasis: the previous attempt kept the small rear boot toe pointing down/right. This attempt must visibly reposition that toe to the LEFT of its ankle and heel, facing lower-left at the SAME angle as the large front boot. The rear heel must be on the RIGHT side of the rear boot, not the left. Use the third image corrected SW05 rear boot as the directional example while preserving this SW06 phase. Keep the front boot unchanged.
